floor.note: The cheating model knows how many minutes he actually played. Even then it's off by 4.18, so that's roughly the floor (shooting luck). The model closes about 35% of the gap between the baseline and the floor; the rest is mostly minutes surprises (injuries, blowouts, foul trouble).

feature_importance.method: permutation importance of the final model on the 2025-26 test set: shuffle one feature, see how much MAE goes up (5 repeats). Features that overlap share credit, so near 0 means nothing new beyond the others.
